audit.why: TRICKY at 46.87% over 1276 games. Mel bullies melee Ekko pre-6; Chronobreak plus a tempo item flip the lane and his roams snowball. Rating fits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Layer disagreement at Level 6: full phases[4].side=Ekko, content win[4]=Mel. Content whys are shifted one row — whys[4] describes level 5 ('he still has no Chronobreak'), whys[5] describes level 6 but sits on the First-item row. Full sides 0-3, 5-6 carry blanket 'Skill' while content and packet name a side.
audit.why: Ekko's 6 is the flip (untargetable rewind + W-E all-in) — the page's own spikes[1] and the full layer agree. Packet levelChart's Mel at index 4 is the stale half, consistent with its own defect note (chart too Mel-heavy for 46.87%).
audit.corrected: win[4] Mel->Ekko with whys[4] rewritten to the level-6 case; whys[5] rewritten to first item; full sides aligned; whys 4-6 on full rewritten to match Ekko rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two Do's/Don'ts bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim; 'rewinds to full health' overstates R (it heals a percentage of damage received); reflect scope unstated (Q and W grenade are projectiles, Phase Dive and Chronobreak are not); missing interactions: R untargetability dodges the execute, W shield eats the burst, E is an auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Kit: R 110/80/50s untargetable rewind + percentage heal; W 22s-14s stun zone + shield, projectile-flagged; Q 9s-7s two-hit projectile; E 325-range dash with auto reset.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Chronobreak at 6: he dives with an untargetable rewind — your kill math stops working until it's spent.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: His tempo item plus R snowballs roams and all-ins — the W stun makes even your snare a coin-flip.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Late he flanks with W and resets with R — peel Phase Dive with the snare, save damage for after the rewind.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50 at rank 3 — untargetable rewind that heals; save the execute for after it. - Parallel Convergence (W): 22s — the stun zone and a shield that eats your burst; force it before committing. - Timewinder (Q): 9s, and Rebuttal reflects both hits.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Rebuttal blocks his Q Timewinder both ways and outruns his walk-up — glow forward and the melee reset never starts its combo.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Phase Dive and Chronobreak aren't projectiles — Rebuttal returns Timewinder and the W grenade, but his kill combo comes through the glow.

edits.before: At 5 he still has no Chronobreak, so your zone control and snare stay ahead.
edits.after: Level 6 Chronobreak lets him dive with an untargetable reset and win the all-in.

edits.before: Level 6 Chronobreak lets Ekko dive with a reset and win the all-in.
edits.after: A tempo first item turns his roams and W-stun combo into a snowball.

edits.before: Chronobreak (R) changes everything: Ekko can dive you, and if it goes wrong he rewinds to full health and safety. His W stun into E Phase Dive all-in becomes lethal with ignite, so respect his 6 and hold E Solar Snare for his dash-in.
edits.after: Chronobreak (R) changes everything: Ekko can dive you, and if it goes wrong he rewinds away untargetable, healing a share of what he took. His W stun into E Phase Dive all-in becomes lethal with ignite, so respect his 6 and hold E Solar Snare for the dash.

notes: Level 6 row resolved toward Ekko (full layer + the page's own spikes[1] + kit); content whys were shifted one row and re-seated. Rows 0-3/5-6: content already correct, full sides edited alone per the chart rule. Fixed 'rewinds to full health' — R heals a percentage of damage received, not full. Anti-heal vs Chronobreak (missing interaction) is NOT on the page: report[8] itemization has no Grievous Wounds line and report edits are capped, so left unedited — flag for a future itemization pass. Ekko E auto-reset wind-up tell also unplaced (no natural field within band); recorded here rather than invented.
